description:
This shop's latest 50 ads, newest first, each with its status, run dates, impressions, clicks, listing views and contacts, and price paid.

Returns `ads`.
name: list_ads

ads.description: The shop's ads, newest first (up to 50)

amount_usdc_atomic.description: The price paid, in USDC's smallest unit (6 decimals); null for an ad paid in VND

amount_vnd.description: The price paid in Vietnamese đồng, for an ad paid by bank transfer; null for one paid in USDC

clicks.description: Clicks on the card during its run, once per browser session per 30 minutes

creative_id.description: The ad creative it shows; null for a listing ad

currency.description: What it was paid in: "USDC" over x402, or "VND" by bank transfer (bought by a person at /dashboard/ads)

ends_at.description: When it ends or ended (ISO 8601); null until paid

hours.description: How many hours it runs, as bought

impressions.description: Viewable impressions during its run: at least half the card on screen for one second, once per browser session per 30 minutes

listing_contacts.description: Signed-in buyers who opened the seller's contact over the same days; null when not measurable yet

listing_id.description: The advertised listing; null for a creative ad

listing_views.description: The listing's page views from the day the ad started (to its end, or now): from daily snapshots, so ad and non-ad visits together. Null when not measurable yet, and always for an ad shorter than a day

network.description: The payment network (CAIP-2), or "vietqr" for a bank transfer

starts_at.description: When it started or starts (ISO 8601); null until paid

status.description: "active" (running or booked), "pending" or "unknown" (payment not yet confirmed, see promote_listing) or "review" (being checked by hand)

tx_hash.description: The payment's transaction; null until known

title: List this shop's ads
